parts.text: Give us a process our own agent can run each week to read, summarize and sort our handwritten case notes so each family gets the right referral. The notes stay on our computers.

request.text: Give us a process our own agent can run each week to read, summarize and sort our handwritten case notes so each family gets the right referral. The notes stay on our computers.

solution.next_step: A person at the nonprofit decides whether to use this process.

practice.expect: A two-sentence summary in plain words, and one suggested referral from the organization's own list, such as emergency rental help. A person decides the referral.
practice.input: Practice case: an example, not a real person or case. Scanned note, Tuesday. A family of four is two months behind on rent after a job loss and asks about help with rent and groceries.

practice.expect: A short summary that marks the unreadable line instead of guessing, and a suggested transport partner from the organization's own list.
practice.input: Practice case: an example, not a real person or case. Scanned note, Thursday. An older man needs rides to weekly medical appointments; the handwriting is hard to read in one line.

practice.expect: A summary with both needs, and two suggested partners from the organization's own list, one for training and one for childcare.
practice.input: Practice case: an example, not a real person or case. Scanned note, Friday. A young woman asks for help applying to a job-training program and for childcare during classes.

task.input: A folder of scanned notes on your own computer
task.output: One short summary and one suggested referral per note, for a person to check
task.schedule: Recurring: once a week, when you start it. It never starts by itself.
task.title: Run: summarize and sort this week's case notes

task_object.description: A process your own agent runs on your own computers. It reads scanned handwritten case notes, writes a short plain-language summary of each and suggests a referral partner from your own published list. A person checks every summary and makes every referral.
holds: Instructions: what the agent does, step by step, and what it must refuse
Skills: read handwriting, summarize a note, suggest a referral partner
Tests and example cases that show it works
how_to: Scan or photograph this week's notes into one folder on your own computer.
Start the task below with your own agent. It reads only that folder.
Check each summary and suggested referral. A person decides every referral.
install: Use an agent you already trust, such as a coding agent on your computer or a container your IT team runs.
Copy the process folder: its instructions, skills, tests and example cases.
Run the tests once on the example cases before you use real notes.
task_object.title: Read, summarize and sort handwritten case notes
